_handoff.scope: Public-workflow pass for changing the recorded holder/name on an existing BWSSB water or underground-drainage account in Bengaluru. Only unauthenticated official/public pages were inspected. No RR number, mobile number, OTP, account, document, payment, complaint, or submission was entered.
_handoff.observationNote: The public Jaladhare entry is directly observed but is for new/additional connections and status lookup. A transfer/name-change path, eligibility decision, fee, document validation, and case outcome remain Unknown.

meta.title: Bengaluru BWSSB existing water-account transfer public workflow
meta.disclaimer: Research handoff, not official advice. It records public interface boundaries and does not establish an application procedure for a specific RR number.

claims.text: The public Jaladhare entry presents mobile-OTP access, an application-number status lookup, and new/additional connection information.
claims.notes: No identifier or OTP was submitted.

claims.text: No transfer, name-change, or existing-account mutation control was visible in the inspected unauthenticated Jaladhare view.
claims.notes: This does not rule out an authenticated, office, or separate route.

claims.text: BWSSB's public contact material provides 1916 and the Jaladhare FAQ's enquiry contact for questions, but does not promise that support can amend an account holder.
claims.notes: No call, email, or grievance was made.

claims.text: The inspected public workflow does not reveal required transfer documents, arrears or deposit treatment, transfer fee, case status, approval decision, or completion timing for any RR number.
claims.notes: Property-specific facts were intentionally not supplied.

nodes.label: Inspect public Jaladhare entry
nodes.summary: Unauthenticated public entry with mobile OTP and new-connection/status controls.
nodes.requiredState: No identifier is needed to inspect the page; an OTP would be required to proceed, but none was requested.

checks.label: OTP and status controls
checks.description: Public page shows mobile-OTP access and application-number status controls.

nodes.label: Identify transfer route
nodes.summary: Determine whether the current transfer/name-change route is public, authenticated, office-based, or separate from Jaladhare.
nodes.requiredState: An existing RR number and case type would be needed for an authorised answer; neither was supplied.

checks.label: No visible mutation control
checks.description: The inspected public view does not expose a transfer/name-change control.

failureSignals.label: Transfer route absent from public entry
failureSignals.description: A consumer sees only new/additional connection and status controls.

recoveries.label: Ask BWSSB for authorised route
recoveries.description: Use published BWSSB contacts to confirm the current RR-specific route before sending documents.

nodes.label: RR-specific evidence and charges
nodes.summary: Potential ownership, succession, identity, bill, arrears, and deposit evidence would be case-specific.
nodes.requiredState: An authorised route must first establish which documents and charges apply.

failureSignals.label: Case requirements unavailable
failureSignals.description: Public pages do not show transfer document validation or fee calculation.

recoveries.label: Pause before upload
recoveries.description: Do not upload documents or pay until BWSSB confirms the route and current checklist.

nodes.label: Published support route
nodes.summary: Published helpline/enquiry leads for clarifying an account-transfer route.
nodes.requiredState: A real case may require RR and identity information, but none was shared in this pass.

checks.label: 1916 and enquiry contact
checks.description: BWSSB pages publish 1916 and an enquiry contact.

nodes.label: Transfer outcome
nodes.summary: Account-name update, rejection, pending status, and effective billing state.
nodes.requiredState: A submitted RR-specific case would be required; no case exists in this research.

edges.label: Public entry inspection precedes determining whether an existing-account transfer route is exposed.
A confirmed route would determine documents, arrears/deposit treatment, and charges; this transition is not observed.
Only an authorised submitted case could produce a transfer decision or updated account; none was submitted.
When the public route is absent, published BWSSB support contacts are the next clarification lead.

roadblocks.title: Transfer/name-change path not visible
roadblocks.symptom: Public Jaladhare page exposes new/additional connection controls but no existing-account mutation control.
roadblocks.likelyCause: Separate authenticated, office, or unindexed route; current implementation unknown.
roadblocks.recovery: Confirm the RR-specific authorised route through BWSSB's published contacts; no case data was entered.

roadblocks.title: RR-specific requirements unavailable
roadblocks.symptom: No public case reveals accepted evidence, arrears, deposits, fee, or timing.
roadblocks.likelyCause: Case data and transfer workflow are not exposed unauthenticated.
roadblocks.recovery: Do not infer requirements from BWSSB's separate new-connection checklist; obtain current confirmation first.

journeys.title: Existing BWSSB water-account transfer — public boundary
journeys.context: Inspect public entry, determine whether transfer is exposed, and preserve the boundary where RR-specific route and evidence are unknown.

steps.label: Open public entry
steps.action: Inspect the public Jaladhare entry without entering an identifier.
steps.expectedResult: Mobile OTP/status and new-connection controls are visible; no case is created.

steps.label: Check for mutation route
steps.action: Look for transfer/name-change controls in the unauthenticated page.
steps.expectedResult: No such control is observed; separate route remains possible.

steps.label: Pause before case data
steps.action: Do not upload sale, succession, identity, or billing documents until BWSSB confirms the current route.
steps.expectedResult: Documents, fee, arrears/deposit handling, and timing remain Unknown.

recoveryNotes: No RR number, OTP, login, document, payment, complaint, or submission was made.
Use only BWSSB-published support contacts for route confirmation.
documentationQualityNotes: Current public controls are directly observed.
